howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会主动预测你的需求、在回答前先记录关键信息、在上下文丢失后自动恢复，并持续自我改进。
howto.when: 每次你发送消息时，Claude 会扫描其中的修正、偏好、决定等关键细节；当上下文使用超过 60% 时，会启动工作缓冲区记录所有对话。

say.text: 帮我记住这个项目的截止日期是下周五。
我们刚才讨论到哪了？继续。
say.note: Claude 会从工作缓冲区恢复上下文，并继续之前的任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude proactively anticipates your needs, logs critical details before responding, recovers from context loss, and continuously self-improves.
howto.when_en: Triggered on every message when corrections, preferences, or decisions are detected; also activates working buffer when context exceeds 60%.

say_en.text: Remember that the project deadline is next Friday.
say_en.note: Claude will immediately write the deadline to SESSION-STATE.md.
Claude will recover context from the working buffer and resume the task.
